name: Return to Marleth
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: Having inserted a barrel of Marleth's Scalder in the Kharanos Distillery's cellar, you grab a barrel of Thunder Ale as proof of the deed...
narrative.objectives: Bring the barrel of Thunder Ale to Marleth Barleybrew at the Brewnall Village.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Not bad, adventurer! Did you have a hard time getting past their guard?

No matter - many thanks, and if you're ever in need of stout with a kick, don't forget the Barleybrews!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 6 to 7, 765 XP in all.

quests.name: Bitter Rivals
quests.objectiveText: In the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, replace a barrel of Thunder Ale with a Barrel of Barleybrew Scalder.

quests.name: Return to Marleth
quests.objectiveText: Bring the barrel of Thunder Ale to Marleth Barleybrew at the Brewnall Village.
